    A seat at the table

    Bring the other hero from 30 health to zero. Your twenty-card deck has crew, tricks and equipment. You can have three crew members on the table.

    Your opening hand

    The first hero chooses from three cards and draws a fourth when their turn starts. The second hero chooses from four, then receives a free Lucky Coin after both hands are ready. Play it for one extra energy this turn. Both heroes draw at the start of every turn.

    Each turn

    1. Draw a card. Refill your energy; its maximum grows by one, up to ten.
    2. Play cards by spending their blue energy cost. Select a card, then play it or choose its highlighted target. Drag crew into the lit crew row, untargeted tricks into the lit table area, and targeted cards onto a highlighted character. Release elsewhere or press Escape to cancel without spending energy.
    3. Drag a ready crew member onto a highlighted enemy, or select it and click the enemy. Crew deal damage to each other at the same time.
    4. Use your hero power, claim the pot, or end your turn. Targeted powers and the pot also support dragging onto a highlighted target.

    The little details that win a brawl

    Guard
    Attacks must hit an enemy Guard first. Tricks can bypass Guard.
    Skirmish
    May attack enemy crew immediately, once. Guard still applies. Cannot attack heroes on its entry turn.
    Ward
    Blocks the next positive damage event, then breaks. Does not block sacrifice, destruction or return. Multiple Wards do not stack.
    Last Orders
    Triggers once when a crew dies, including sacrifice. Returning or burning a card does not trigger it.
    Setup
    Requires another card played earlier this turn. Coin and equipment count. Attacks, powers and pot claims do not.
    Legendary
    One copy of each Legendary per twenty-card deck. Other cards allow two. All 49 cards are available.
    New crew
    Wait until your next turn to attack, unless they have Skirmish. A gold edge and “Ready” mark attackers that can act.
    Battlecry
    Happens when you play the crew member. A targeted Battlecry is skipped only when there is no legal target. Mother Nox needs another friendly crew and an empty place to enter.
    Pocket Sand
    The target misses its next attack turn. Its Guard still protects the table.
    Temporary bonuses
    “This turn” ends when the turn ends. Losing a health bonus never kills an otherwise surviving crew member.
    The pot
    At three coins or more, spend two energy to empty it and give one crew member +1 attack per three coins, up to +3, for this turn. Once per turn. In a new trail, your claim costs one energy and you may instead restore 2 hero health per three coins, up to 6. Both options empty the pot and share the once-per-turn limit.
    Your hand
    Eight cards maximum; excess draws burn face up. An empty hand does not end the battle: your crew and hero power can still act. Every attempted draw from an empty deck deals fatigue damage: 1, then 2, then 3, and so on. Extra draws and the Owl’s power also trigger fatigue. At 200 turns, the tavern closes with a draw.

    Online deadlines

    You have 45 seconds to choose your opening hand; any unconfirmed hand is kept when time runs out. Each turn lasts 75 seconds, then ends automatically. A pending Nightglass choice takes the original top card at timeout; making a choice does not restart the clock. Menus and connection interruptions do not stop the clock. A lost connection has a 15-second grace period; failing to reconnect forfeits the match. Leaving a live table also forfeits it.

    The tavern trail

    Win seven battles with the same evolving deck. Choose your starting deck and challenge before beginning. The house gives you one extra starting energy crystal. Relaxed has gentler decks and full recovery after wins. Standard restores 12 health, to at least 20; Sharp restores 8. Then choose one of three card swaps or a permanent relic, while available. Inspect friendly crew or open the battle menu to dismiss one for 1 energy, once per turn: it goes to discard without triggering Last Orders. Your pot claims cost 1 energy and can heal instead of boosting attack. A loss or draw ends the run. Saved older trails keep their original recovery, rewards and battle rules. Your progress saves after every decision.

    Click a deck or discard pile to inspect public information. Right-click or long-press a hand card to read it. Escape cancels a selection; E ends your turn. Reduced motion is available in Options.

    Options

    Computer difficulty applies to quick duels. New trails let you choose their own challenge: Relaxed fully heals between battles, Standard restores 12 health to at least 20, and Sharp restores 8. Existing trails keep their chosen challenge. Your device's reduced-motion preference is also respected.
